## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Three-Kingdoms Wú translation of a discourse on the conversion of a Jaina household by Sumati 須摩提, the daughter of Anāthapiṇḍika 阿那邠邸, who has married into a Jain family in a different country and uses her devotion to the Buddha to convert her in-laws. The Chinese parallel is T125[30.3]; T128 has two consecutive Taishō entries (a, b) — sister-versions by Zhī Qiān, see [T128b](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0130).

**Abstract**

T129 was produced during Zhī Qiān's Wú-court translation period (222–253 CE), recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost.
